text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Birth history unremarkable. Social history: Lives with both parents and one older sibling. No known exposure to sick contacts or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to confirm if the abdomen feels distended or if the liver is enlarged and firm to the touch, as well as whether the child has shown signs of sudden weight gain or fatigue. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound and Echocardiogram.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal Examination shows mild distension with the liver palpable 1.5 times the normal size for age; Echocardiogram findings confirm the presence of an atrial septal defect with a left to right shunt and an enlarged cardiac silhouette.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the echocardiogram results showing a left-to-right shunt and the physical findings of an enlarged liver and leg swelling, I suspect the child is developing congestive heart failure secondary to the atrial septal defect. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure due to Atrial Septal Defect.
